what_was_searched: open.ngis.uz UZKAD/MAHALLA_UZKAD_DB16 FeatureServer queried for the whole of soato_region=1726 (no bbox or scale limit); groupBy count by district confirms 402 features and 402 distinct cadastral numbers
best_source_found: The cadastre mahalla layer itself (402 of 585 = 68.7%)
why_data_is_still_missing: The layer is being populated progressively - create_at values for the Tashkent subset run 2026-03-14 to 2026-08-27, i.e. loading was still in progress three weeks before the access date. The 183 absent mahallas are simply not yet published, not deleted.
recommended_next_source: Re-query the same FeatureServer monthly; coverage should rise. If a deadline applies, request the outstanding cadastral drawings from Davlat kadastr palatasi under Cabinet Res. No. 48 art. 28.

what_was_searched: stat.uz, siat.stat.uz, api.siat.stat.uz, hudud.stat.uz (all API routes), toshstat.uz, data.egov.uz catalogue and apiClient API, aholi.stat.uz 2026 census release, mahalla.uz (dead domain), Raqamli Mahalla, HDX, WorldPop, IPUMS (no Uzbekistan coverage)
best_source_found: hudud.stat.uz - district (tuman) level only, 12 units for Tashkent
why_data_is_still_missing: No Uzbek public source publishes population below tuman level. The 2026 census preliminary release stops at city level. This is a publication-policy limit, not a search failure.
recommended_next_source: Formal request to Milliy statistika qoʻmitasi or Toshkent shahar statistika boshqarmasi for the mahalla-level table of the 2026 census; alternatively the Mahalla va oilani qoʻllab-quvvatlash vazirligi holds registration-based counts.
official_information_request_needed: YES - this is the main blocker

what_was_searched: Etirof register returns an empty ruName for every Tashkent record; no Cyrillic or Russian variant field exists in the cadastre mahalla layer
why_data_is_still_missing: The official register simply does not carry the other scripts for Tashkent. Mechanical transliteration was deliberately NOT performed, because several names are proper nouns whose Russian forms differ from a letter-by-letter conversion (e.g. Olmazor / Алмазар, Sergeli / Сергели).
recommended_next_source: The 2023-2024 Kengash decision annexes on lex.uz are published in Cyrillic and would give authoritative Cyrillic forms. Retrieve those PDFs per district.

best_source_found: A 12-row dataset - one district-level coordinator, not a mahalla-level directory
why_data_is_still_missing: No public mahalla-level directory was found.
recommended_next_source: Request from Toshkent shahar hokimligi, or scrape district kengash.gov.uz sub-portals.
